title: Eisenkot, Netanyahu’s Main Rival in Israel’s Election, Faces a Dilemma
summary_full: To form a government, Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot needs to either join forces with Arab parties — anathema to many Israelis — or with members of Benjamin Netanyahu’s alliance.
